company.name: HealthKey
company.shortDescription: HealthKey is a platform that connects employers and insurers with health providers.
company.description: HealthKey operates in the insurance industry, focusing on healthcare. The company connects health insurers with healthcare providers and patients, aiming to make personalized healthcare more accessible. HealthKey works to address health inequities, which are avoidable differences in health between groups. It also focuses on the prevention, treatment, and management of illness, as well as the preservation of mental and physical well-being.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,098,071 to $9,098,071, a 1x increase.
